candidates.headline: Kubiak keeps Raiders' QB race going: 'We got another week'
candidates.description: With one week left in the preseason, Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said he wasn't prepared to name a starting quarterback, adding "I don't want anyone to be comfortable in their job."

candidates.headline: A.J. Brown, Jalen Hurts reunite briefly amid post-trade rift
candidates.description: A.J. Brown and Jalen Hurts caught up for a few minutes after practice Thursday -- a notable development after the Patriots receiver revealed Wednesday that the former teammates had not spoken since he was traded to New England by the Eagles.

candidates.headline: Vita Vea dismisses trade drama: I want 'to be a Buc for life'
candidates.description: Vita Vea says his end goal was never a trade away from Tampa Bay, adding he wants to be "a Buc for life."
